corrected_content.problem:
![](images/f5/f54e51921dfd2fb1b93bccec89553e174e2527866352626a5bf0846956b096bb.png)

The diagram above shows the vector $\mathbf{a}$. Which of the following diagrams shows the vector $-\frac{1}{2}\mathbf{a}$?
corrected_content.worked_solution: The vector $-\tfrac12a$ has half the length of $a$ and the opposite direction. The original vector points northeast, so the correct diagram shows a vector half as long pointing southwest.
